version_or_date_checked: iOS 9.0.7 (released 2026-10-02), Android updated 2026-10-02; help center (65 articles via WP API) and site checked 2026-10-02
pricing: Free with no ads and unlimited logging. Premium (US App Store): $16.90/month, $37.90/3 months, $109/year; 14-day free trial mentioned on official blog; Swedish wellness-stipend invoices (1-year). Paywalled: full program catalog, advanced stats & training reports, muscle map, RPE/RIR logging, RPE calculator, %1RM/RPE programming, quick set stats, Train-again bulk modify, sharing to other users, unlimited goals/streaks/progress-pic bundles.
platforms: iOS 15+ (iPhone/iPad, visionOS), Apple Watch (watchOS 9+), Android with Wear OS app + Tiles, Health Connect; Flutter web build at app.strengthlog.com (scope unclear).
positioning: Swedish, ad-free 'most generous' freemium strength log built by lifters, with a large coach-written program library, educational exercise content, PRs per rep count, goals/streaks/challenges.

features.how: Each exercise defines its variables at creation (strength exercises must include weight; reps, time and distance variants exist; cardio tracks distance/pace). Data can only be moved between exercises with the same variables.

Warm-up vs working set (long-press set number to toggle), drop sets with '+ New drop', 'Max reps' and 'Fail' flags (fail counts to volume but not records); special sets: superset, circuit, complex, EMOM, Tabata, AMRAP.
Premium: toggle RPE or RiR per set or permanently per exercise; RPE calculator (premium) suggests weights for target reps/RPE from your last set; RPE/RIR also usable when building programs.

App shows previous performance per exercise; swipe exercise > History lists all past sessions (with set comments) and lets you copy a block in (replace or add). Premium 'quick stats' per set show rep-PR at that weight and average reps.

'Copy sets from last workout' checkbox when adding an exercise; templates/programs can use 'Retrieve from log' (finds last set with the same rep count, or a heavier one with more reps; warm-ups match warm-ups); 'Train again' clones a whole past workout (premium: bulk +/- weight/reps).
Set comments (swipe set), pinned exercise comments shown every time (machine settings/cues), workout-specific exercise comments (v9.0), and a workout comment plus name at save.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-09 (1*): after 9.0 it is 'harder to access notes for your workouts'. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: '+ Special set' > Superset is exactly two exercises (each marked done individually; can split or reorder); Circuit for 3+ exercises/rounds; Complex for same-weight barbell sequences completed as one set.
Long-press an exercise border (or ... > Handle exercise > Reorder) opens a drag-and-drop list; sets can be moved up/down via set menu arrows.
Swipe exercise > Change: library opens with similar exercises suggested first; weights are kept as-is (or fetch from history/update 1RM).

Free: loading image above keyboard for barbell exercises, full calculator in Settings > Calculators; profiles per gym with plate counts, plate colors, barbells and collars; link exercises to a specific bar (e.g., 28 kg trap bar; 0 kg bar for plate-loaded machines).
'Warm-up for max attempt' calculator plans warm-up sets for a target weight and can create a workout; no automatic warm-up generation for normal working sets found.
Exercises can carry a 'bodyweight factor' that adds a share of bodyweight to lifted weight/volume (editable or 0 to exclude). No dedicated assisted/band-assistance mode documented.
One-sided exercises are 'Enter for only one side': log one side's reps/weight once and the app doubles volume; no separate L/R fields.
No tempo field or tempo timer found in help center; users request it.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-07 (5*): 'just need a tempo timer with concentric and eccentric'. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: + (bottom menu) > Start New Workout, then '+ Exercise' from Most used / All exercises.
Edit any saved workout (sets, name, time, ratings); backdate by logging and changing date/time at save; v9.0 home calendar lets you backlog forgotten workouts; delete from home widget or log.
Tap set number to mark done (turns green); swipe actions on sets/exercises; long-press shortcuts; optional XL timer. Users report the done-tap target and 9.0 navigation as unclear.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2023 (3*): 'not made very clear how to mark a workout as done, you end up having to tap the small blank space'; 2026-05 (3*): 'powerful ... buried under baffling UX decisions'. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Timer settings let it start automatically on set completion; progress bar in background; +/-30 s buttons or manual entry; count-up mode.
Exercise-specific rest timers set in timer settings or via ... > Handle Exercise > Exercise specific rest timer; 'Reset to default'.
Rest-over notifications with selectable sound (permission required; no sound in silent mode).
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-09 (3*): 'Timer stopped working in iOS 27'. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: No mention of Live Activity/Dynamic Island in help center, store text or release notes.

Time-based exercises and Time PR goals exist; EMOM/Tabata/AMRAP special sets have full-screen interval timers with countdown and sounds. A per-set stopwatch for e.g. planks is not documented in detail.
Workout clock with fullscreen pause (since v5.10.2); paused time can be entered manually at save; duration feeds calorie estimate.
No auto-end; at save you can correct time/paused time, and unfinished sets/exercises can be deleted or moved to a new planned workout.
Mine > + > Workout: named, colored templates with set weight, retrieve-from-log or % of 1RM (premium) per set; any logged workout can be saved as a template; favorites appear on home.
Workout categories: create categories and 'Move to...' templates into them.

200+ programs and stand-alone workouts (powerlifting, bodybuilding, powerbuilding, PPL, sport-specific) filterable by Free/Premium, level and category; 'Follow program' puts next workout on home; skip/unfollow; full catalog is Premium.

Multi-week program builder (copy week to next week and edit), % of 1RM sets (premium) using stored 'My 1RMs', RPE/RIR-based sets (premium), retrieve-from-log + fixed progression increment (premium). v9.0 adds Simple and Detailed builders with Smart Blocks.
No AI generator. Minigames (Name Game, Dice Game, Card Game) generate randomized bodyweight-style sets; Smart Blocks automate progression but you pick exercises.
Plan a workout for a date (home widget + calendar); v9.0 home calendar to start, plan, add events and schedule followed programs.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-09 (1*): 'I used to be able to easily plan a workout. That option is no longer available' after 9.0. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Share own program, planned or completed workout via link (share sheet); sharer needs Premium, receiver needs app v6.0+; only standard exercises; receiver needs Premium if it uses premium features.
Help center (Apr 2026) says 'over 600 exercises'; store listing says 500+ strength, mobility and cardio exercises (website still says 450+).
Each exercise: written instructions, GIF, muscle map, and self-recorded videos (since v8.1), aiming for one male and one female demo per exercise.

Unlimited custom exercises (free): from scratch or copied from existing; type (strength/cardio/mobility), variables, primary/secondary muscles, bodyweight factor, one-sided flag. Delete requires moving logged data to an exercise with same variables.
Primary (dark red) and secondary (pink) muscles per exercise drive the muscle map.
Filter by equipment type (long-press to isolate one), by muscle via tappable body map, and standard vs own exercises.
Search plus 'Most used' list that adapts to your own usage; sort alphabetically or by usage.

App Store lists English only; the official web build contains a full Swedish translation and an in-app language switch (English/Swedish). (evidence: UI strings in StrengthLog's official Flutter web build; release status in mobile app not confirmed by help center)

Rule-based, not adaptive: v9.0 Smart Blocks with Linear (weight up when all reps done), Double (rep range then weight) and Triple progression (reps, then sets, then weight); older Retrieve-from-log + fixed increment (premium); % of 1RM programs.
features.user_feedback: Third-party review: 'the decision of when to add weight, when to deload ... sits with you' (pre-9.0 assessment). https://steelrep.app/blog/best-workout-apps-strength-training/

features.how: Smart Block 'Double progression': choose rep range and weight increase; when top of range is hit on all sets, weight rises and reps reset.
No automatic deload rules documented in the help center; third-party review states it has no deload logic.
At save you rate sleep, stress, calorie intake and how the workout felt ('shape'); premium stats compare e.g. experienced shape vs reps. No readiness model adjusting training.
No AI coach in help center (65 articles), store listing or release notes.

Automatic PR for every rep count (1RM..nRM), Yearly Records ('YR!') and PR ('PR!') badges inline while logging, Time PR; records page per year; add old PRs manually, delete bad records; attach videos to records.
Estimated 1RM graphs per exercise; 1RM calculator uses Epley; logged RPE/RIR adjusts e1RM (easier RPE -> higher e1RM). Separate 'My 1RMs' registry for %1RM programs (premium).
Basic stats free; advanced per-exercise graphs (e1RM, reps by %1RM zones, etc.) premium; graphs can be favorited to home, reordered/recolored (v9.0) and overlaid with calendar events.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-01 (3*): 'All stats and graphs are entirely locked behind premium which is a comical $100+ a year.' https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Free volume and workout stats with period comparison on home 'Overview'; premium adds per-muscle-group statistics, weekly set goals per muscle and monthly/yearly reports.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-09 (4*): 'a real bummer that you can't even get a weekly summary of work' (free). https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Premium 'Muscles worked' map: sets per muscle over a chosen period, grey to full red at the weekly set goal (default 10, editable globally or per muscle); also as iOS widget.

Training log calendar with events; Streaks: manual check-off or workout-logging streaks (reps, volume, sets, number of workouts; daily/weekly) with reminders, longest streak, share image. Free has a limit; unlimited in premium.

Summary after saving (incl. estimated calories burned since v5.10); premium monthly/yearly Training Reports (workouts, volume, reps, sets, time, muscles, top exercises, PRs, compare with previous period, share image).

Strength Levels (since v8.0): general level from your 15 most-logged lifts plus per-exercise levels vs app users (Beginner 5%, Novice 25%, Intermediate 50%, Advanced 75%, Elite 95%), filterable by sex, age, bodyweight; needs sex, age, bodyweight and 3+ logged lifts; shareable image.
Body measurement page: + to add a dated bodyweight entry, graph per measurement; can read bodyweight from Health Connect.
Multiple body measurements with dated entries and graphs; body-measurement goals; body fat % calculator pulls stored measurements.
Progress pic 'bundles' stored privately in the cloud with a photo-taking guide; free accounts hit a bundle limit, premium raises it.
Post-workout ratings for sleep quality, stress, calorie intake and 'how it felt'; no HRV or morning check-in.

iOS: shares workouts (and active energy) to Apple Health, does not read data back. Android: Health Connect (replaced Google Fit in v6.8); can read bodyweight and Wear OS heart rate; bulk upload of missing history.

Apple Watch app (since v5.11; watchOS 9+): start workouts or continue ones started on phone, add exercises/sets; %1RM workouts need 1RMs entered first. Wear OS app with Tiles for goals, streaks, weekly stats, challenges and heart rate.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2025-04 (2*): Apple Watch 'stopped working with the latest update'. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: No Garmin/Fitbit integration found (a 2026 review asks for Fitbit); Strava connection (load Strava activities into calendar, share workouts to Strava) appears in the app strings. (evidence: UI strings in StrengthLog's official Flutter web build; release status in mobile app not confirmed by help center)
No import from Strong/Hevy documented; can import bodyweight history from Health; old PRs entered manually.
Export training log and/or body measurements as .csv (Settings); third-party importers (e.g., Gript) read this export incl. RPE and timed sets.
Account-based cloud sync; data appears on a new device after login; subscriptions do not transfer between iOS and Android.
iOS home-screen widgets: muscles worked (small/large, period editable), monthly challenge, goals (1 or 4), streaks; Wear OS Tiles.
Not mentioned in help center or store listing.
Only plate-calculator profiles per gym (e.g., 'original gym' and 'home gym') with their own plates, bars and collars.
Plate calculator inventory: plate counts per profile, barbells, collars, exercise-specific bar; not used to round program weights.
Exercise list can be filtered by equipment type; Similar Exercises suggests swaps if equipment is missing. No availability profile per gym.

Terms describe social features: mutual friend connections (username/QR) sharing workout summaries, PRs, e1RMs and Strength Levels, never the full log; app strings include feed posts and reporting; v9.0 library has a 'Following' filter. (evidence: UI strings in StrengthLog's official Flutter web build; release status in mobile app not confirmed by help center)

Image for sharing (choose background, format, stats) to Instagram or save; full-workout image; share workouts/programs to other users via link (premium); share images for streaks, reports and strength levels.
No ranked leaderboards found; Strength Levels compare you against all app users as percentiles.
Monthly app-wide challenges (usually 3 sub-goals) with badges and archive; achievements; friend-invite challenges are described in the Terms and app strings.
No coach/client accounts in help center or store listing.
Programs can be shared by link (premium sharer); no assignment/tracking of clients.
Not present in help center or store listing.
No in-app chat; support via app@strengthlog.com.
Programs are authored by StrengthLog coaches only; no third-party marketplace.

Free: unlimited logging, no ads, custom exercises, basic stats, PRs, plate calculator, timer, many programs, basic program builder, limited goals/streaks. Premium (US App Store: $16.90/month, $37.90/3 months, $109/year; 14-day trial per blog): full program catalog, advanced stats/reports, muscle map, RPE/RIR, %1RM programming, quick stats, Train-again modifications, sharing, unlimited goals/streaks. Sweden: wellness-stipend invoices. Cannot be bought on web.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2025-06 (1*) '$16 / month!', 2025-01 (3*) 'Pro is wayyy too expensive'; many 5* reviews praise the generous free tier. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: kg or lb globally; plate calculator has its own weight-unit setting; km/miles for cardio. No per-exercise unit documented.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-01 (2*): wants easier conversion between meter/kilo units. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Dark mode by default; toggle to light in settings (system setting option exists).

Store lists English only; app strings include Swedish with an in-app language switch. (evidence: UI strings in StrengthLog's official Flutter web build; release status in mobile app not confirmed by help center)
No accessibility documentation; the Flutter build contains semantic labels (e.g., 'switch language to swedish'), but VoiceOver/Dynamic Type support is unverified.
Achievements are explicitly designed to help users learn the app; in-app News and Help; no documented setup wizard.
Data is stored locally and backed up to servers only when online; a temporary (anonymous) account exists, but the FAQ says an account is required. Premium status may fail to load on bad connection.

Account required (Google, Apple, Facebook or email); GDPR rights incl. portability; processors outside EU/EEA under SCCs; account deletion via email request; de-identified data used for Strength Levels. App Store: contact info, user ID, diagnostics linked to identity.
Start an exact copy of any logged workout from home/log; premium lets you bulk-adjust reps/weight (e.g., +1%) before starting.
EMOM (intervals in 15 s steps, blocks alternate), Tabata (default 20/10 x8), AMRAP (time cap, add rounds while timer runs) and Complex, with full-screen timer, countdown and audio cues.

9 goal types: reps, volume, sets, number of workouts, PR, e1RM, time PR, rep goal at weight, body measurement; date range, exercise or muscle-group scope, live progress graph; free limited, unlimited in premium.
Upload a video to a set (live or past) or a PR; videos collected in a searchable library, downloadable.
1RM (Epley), plate, RPE (premium), warm-up for max attempt, powerlifting attempt selection (91/96/100%), Wilks & IPF GL, Sinclair, daily calories, protein, body fat & fat-free mass.
Swipe a set for e1RM, % of 1RM, rep-PR, average reps at that weight, bodyweight multiple.
Tag dates with events (sick, vacation, period, injury) and overlay them on statistics graphs.
Estimated kcal per workout from duration (and bodyweight); can be sent to Apple Health Active Energy.
Draggable home widgets: overview stats, muscles worked, programs you follow, latest workouts, goals, planned workouts, favorite graphs, news, pinned strength levels, challenges, streaks.
features.user_feedback: App Store 2026-09 (1-2*): 9.0 moved next program workout off home and filled it with unrelated widgets. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json

features.how: Start next workout of one followed program, then another, and import it into the active workout (name combines both).
Multi-level achievements (Log Workouts 10 levels, Compound Hero, Follow a Program, etc.) with badges on profile.
Name Game, Dice Game and Card Game generate exercises/reps on the fly and auto-add completed sets.
A Flutter web build runs at app.strengthlog.com and the Terms mention a 'web version'; premium cannot be bought there. Feature scope undocumented.
v9.0 (Sep 2026) rebuilt Program Builder with Simple and Detailed modes and Smart Blocks; favorites/Following filters; major navigation reshuffle (Profile, Statistics, Library).
features.user_feedback: Recent App Store reviews (Sep 2026) split: '9.0 is SICK' vs 'New app layout is awful', 'changing things for the sake of changing things'. https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=1434229662/sortBy=mostRecent/json
